page.overview:
Who is Enuk?

Enuk came from a proud and successful Southern Water Tribe family. After they gained airbending abilities following the Harmonic Convergence during the life of Avatar Korra, they joined up with the Air Nation to explore their new abilities and fully explore who they really were. When they left, the duties of carrying on the family tradition fell to their younger sibling, Changunak.

Enuk participated in the Air Nation's defense of the spirits three years after Harmonic Convergence. After Changunak came to Republic City, Enuk hoped to protect her from the dangers and stresses of the city, and the burden that they left behind.

Enuk was a capable airbender. They incorporated their Water Tribe origins into their distinct style of airbending, and they often created long, flowing winds like streams of water.
